input: Five original-C-based ranked standing uniforms for one character, ordered C, B, A, S, S+.

roles.bulk: Bulk, towering 194cm heavy dark fully enclosed armor, broad unified plates, narrow amber visor, short raised rear collar, a pistol extended in right hand and modern tactical shield on left arm
roles.raven: Raven, 170cm Asian woman, original recognizable face and long black high ponytail, signature red scarf, sleeveless fitted vest, bare arms, fitted military cargo trousers, dual compact dark SMGs
roles.lynx: Lynx, 170cm slender and agile hooded masked marksman, layered long ragged cloak, narrow amber eyes, long thin scoped rifle
roles.hammer: Hammer, 176cm long-legged elite soldier, rugged short-bearded face, steel helmet with orange ear defenders, short rolled sleeves and bare muscular forearms, compact stout tubular rocket launcher and a cylindrical pack
roles.cct: CCT, tall lean 182cm radio controller, tactical helmet with raised NVG and headset, olive radio backpack with thin antenna, rolled field sleeves, compact black carbine

actions.travel: Walking horizontally to screen right, three-quarter SIDE VIEW nearly profile; compact low-ready hold throughout, steady tactical stride.
actions.level: Moving forward to screen right WHILE FIRING HORIZONTALLY, camera almost side-on. The barrel is held LEVEL and points right in EVERY frame. Engage the legs in an anatomically drawn walking cycle; restrained changes in elbows, no exaggerated recoil.
actions.up: Moving to screen right while aiming the weapon diagonally UP RIGHT at 43 degrees, head tracking the aim. Barrel points distinctly upper right throughout.
actions.zenith: Moving to screen right while aiming VERY STEEPLY UP, muzzle almost vertically above the head, approximately 78 degrees upwards. Within every cell leave room ABOVE the helmet for the barrel.
actions.down: Moving to screen right while aiming the weapon diagonally DOWN RIGHT at 42 degrees. Barrel points clearly down in every frame.
actions.nadir: Moving to screen right while aiming VERY STEEPLY DOWN, muzzle almost vertically toward ground about 75 degrees, firearm close in front of knees. Keep both shoulders level.
actions.toward: Walking tactically diagonally TOWARD camera, frontal three-quarter view from screen right. See full front of torso. Eyes level and weapon carried ready.
actions.away: Walking tactically diagonally AWAY from camera, BACK three-quarter view from screen right. See the upper back, rear helmet and backpack or cloak; head and barrel face away.
actions.guard: Stationary on the identical foot marks, full-height upright sentry pose like the reference, weapon low ready. Six subtle independently painted idle keyframes; small natural breath, minimal chin and hand motion. Both soles remain planted, keep legs apart like the reference; do not walk.
actions.skill: Perform the character's specialty in six consecutive keyframes. Bulk the shield-bearing tank smoothly lowers from standing guard to his final deep protected crouch behind his tactical shield (weapon hand visible). Lynx the cloaked marksman transitions from standing rifle ready to kneeling horizontally sighted shot. Hammer the rocket specialist lowers from standing with shoulder tube to firm kneeling launcher position pointed right; launcher visible in every frame. CCT brings gloved fingers to the earpiece, kneels to confirm radio traffic and lowers hand back to his carbine. Animate only the specific reference character's one action, not any other character.

motion_template: Use case: identity-preserve. Create one production 2D game sprite atlas on genuine transparent alpha. Reference image shows FIVE ranked uniforms of {character}, left to right C B A S S+. Anatomically matched tall adult proportions, same face, costume details, size and identity as that specific reference. Transfer EACH reference outfit to its own animation row. Art direction: highly detailed realistic hand-painted videogame character, clean outlined forms, consistent lighting and perspective. ACTION FOR THE ENTIRE SHEET: {action} All frames portray one whole individually painted character, naturally articulated knees, feet, pelvis, shoulders, cloth and support hand. No dismembered separate parts or repeated standing cutouts. Exact atlas layout: SIX equally-spaced COLUMNS by FIVE equally-spaced ROWS, exactly 30 full-body figures. Row 1 matches outfit at left of reference, basic C. Row 2 field olive B. Row 3 golden yellow and graphite A. Row 4 scarlet red and black S. Row 5 premium pearl/white and restrained cyan S+. All six figures in each row wear the SAME outfit. Columns chronologically: left foot forward contact, weight transfers down on left, right knee passes planted left, right foot forward contact, weight transfers down on right, left knee passes planted right. Alternate the near and far boots and make each footfall clearly distinct. Keep the heads at the same height and same x inside their cells, steady readable upper body. Complete each frame head-to-sole, including entire weapon and equipment, generous transparent vertical and horizontal gutters to separate each individual cutout. Orthographic game camera, same size across EVERY cell. 6 by 5 regular grid, edges clear, no cell borders, no text, no labels, no decorative background, no floor, no shadows under feet, no bullets or flashes. Max resolution.

standing: Repaint the four promoted uniforms of the reference as full-body portraits. Two columns and two rows, upper left olive B, upper right yellow/graphite A, lower left scarlet/black S, lower right pearl white with restrained cyan S+. Match the face, anatomy, pose, helmet or hair, foot width and weapon angle of the original C design at the left. Each complete figure in a separate transparent cell, no text, no backdrop.
raven_guard_revision: Six individually illustrated subtle idle keyframes per rank. Exposed dark hair contours and a clean transparent backdrop around the ponytail, no glow or cast shadow.
